title: PX4 battery (ULog battery_status, instance 0)
note: PX4 current_a is positive when discharging; remaining is 0-1 and, depending on firmware and BAT_CAPACITY, may be voltage-based rather than coulomb counted. Capacity comes from the logged BAT_CAPACITY parameter (configured, not measured).

recording.time: ULog timestamps, seconds from the first battery_status message

soc.estimator_note: PX4 remaining is voltage-based unless BAT_CAPACITY is set and the estimator fuses coulomb counting; the log does not say which
